portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure that all previously-released
errata relevant to your system have been applied.

This update is available via Red Hat Network.  Details on how to use
the Red Hat Network to apply this update are available at
http://kbase.redhat.com/faq/FAQ_58_10188
portal_description:
The Eclipse Platform allows users to build integrated development
environments, that can be used to create applications, including web sites,
embedded Java and C++ programs, and Enterprise JavaBeans (EJB).

The Eclipse "org/eclipse/core/runtime/Platform.java" file contained the
"public static final String ARCH_IA64 = "ppc64";" string. This could have
caused problems if "ARCH_IA64" was used to enable features on the Itanium
architectures, that do not apply to PowerPC architectures. In these updated
packages, the correct string, "public static final String ARCH_PPC64 =
"ppc64";" has been added, which resolves this issue.

With changes introduced in Mozilla Firefox 3, the embedded browser
component of the Standard Widget Toolkit (SWT), as included in these
updated packages, no longer functions correctly, and as such, it has been
disabled. This causes two user-visible changes:

* when starting Eclipse, the "Welcome" screen is now a simple page with a
white background, instead of the graphical background, as it was when the
embedded browser was used.

* the Eclipse help system now opens a browser window in a tab, instead of a
dedicated window.

User of eclipse are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which
resolve this issue.
